snippet.title: C.A.B.A. - RELEASE WINDOW - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description: C.A.B.A. (Center of Anomalies of Buenos Aires), a short first-person survival horror experience launching with full VR support on PS VR2, Meta Quest, and SteamVR, plus flat versions for PS5 and Steam. Set in a Buenos Aires subway station that shouldn't exist, the game is our take on the Backrooms metro level, a subterranean liminal space rarely explored in video games. You can't fight what walks the tunnels down here; you can only try to escape. Wishlist C.A.B.A. now on all storefronts.
